title: CycloneDX Pre-Defined Perspectives Registry
description: Governs the registry of well-known, pre-defined perspectives (perspectives-defs.json) and declares their reserved identities (preDefinedPerspectivesEnum, referenced by the specification's perspective schema). The identity enum is maintained by hand. The catalog document defining `cdx:perspectives:<name>` is `perspectives/<name>-perspective.json` in the repository, by naming convention, and holds the latest version; its `version` is the perspective version selected by `predefinedVersion`. Every earlier version is kept, unchanged, as `perspectives/archives/<name>-perspective/<name>-perspective-<version>.json`. The registry data is generated: it records every published version of each perspective with the sha256 of the catalog document's canonical JSON and the date it was registered. Once registered, a version's content is immutable; changing a catalog document requires incrementing its `version` by 1 and archiving the previous version. The registry is maintained independently of the CycloneDX specification release cycle.

lastUpdated.title: Last Updated
lastUpdated.description: The date and time (timestamp) of the most recently registered version.

perspectives.title: Pre-Defined Perspectives
perspectives.description: The registered pre-defined perspectives, one entry per identity that has a published catalog document. Identities in the enum without an entry are reserved and not published yet.

preDefinedPerspectivesEnum.title: Pre-Defined Perspective Identities
preDefinedPerspectivesEnum.description: The reserved identities of well-known, pre-defined perspectives, using the reserved cdx:perspectives: namespace path. The catalog document defining `cdx:perspectives:<name>` is `perspectives/<name>-perspective.json`. Referenced by the specification's perspective schema.

meta:enum.cdx:perspectives:model-card: A transparency view for machine learning models following the industry-standard model card structure, covering model details, intended use, training data and procedure, quantitative analysis, technical limitations, and ethical and environmental considerations.
meta:enum.cdx:perspectives:pqc-readiness: A view for assessing readiness for the post-quantum cryptography migration, covering cryptographic inventory, quantum resistance of the cryptography in use, and cryptographic agility.

predefined.title: Pre-Defined Perspective Identity
predefined.description: The reserved identity of the perspective. Matches the `predefined` field of a perspective in a CycloneDX document.

file.title: Catalog Document
file.description: Path, relative to the repository root, of the catalog document defining this perspective at its latest version, as given by the naming convention. Earlier versions are archived under `perspectives/archives/`, also by naming convention.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the perspective, as declared by its catalog document at the latest registered version.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of the perspective, as declared by its catalog document at the latest registered version.

versions.title: Registered Versions
versions.description: Every published version of the perspective, in ascending order, contiguous from 1.

version.title: Version
version.description: The `version` of the catalog document that published this revision; the value a reference selects via `predefinedVersion`.

sha256.title: Content Hash
sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the catalog document's canonical JSON (object keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace) at this version. A catalog document, current or archived, whose hash differs from the one registered for its `version` has changed after publication.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date and time (timestamp) this version was registered.
